pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattūpāhanaṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo chattūpāhanaṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginiyo”ti!
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattūpāhanaṃ dhāressantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattūpāhanaṃ dhārentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattūpāhanaṃ dhāressanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.2: tassā vinā chattūpāhanā na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.5: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.6.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī agilānā chattūpāhanaṃ dhāreyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.1.8: yassā vinā chattūpāhanaṃ na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.1.10: tīṇi chattāni setacchattaṃ kilañjacchattaṃ paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.1: agilānā agilānasaññā chattūpāhanaṃ dhāreti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.2: agilānā vematikā chattūpāhanaṃ dhāreti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.3: agilānā gilānasaññā chattūpāhanaṃ dhāreti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.4: chattaṃ dhāreti na upāhanaṃ āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.5: upāhanaṃ dhāreti na chattaṃ āpatti dukkaṭassa.
